## Checklist / チェックリスト

- [ ] `npm run lint`, `npm run typecheck`, `npm test` and `npx cdk synth --quiet` pass locally
- [ ] Tests added/updated (security-relevant changes include a regression test)
- [ ] No new runtime dependency (or discussed beforehand)
- [ ] No secrets, account ids, domains, hosted zone ids or personal data in code, tests or screenshots
- [ ] Docs updated (README / docs, ja + en) if behavior or setup changed
